description: Run the tests of earlier runs again now, as new runs started together in one batch (Restart and Run again in Test Results). A run from a saved test runs that test as it stands today, so an edit since is tested; any other run repeats the configuration stored on it. The earlier runs stay as they are. Name the runs by number, or give the batch_id of a launch to run all of it again. Returns the new batch_id, each new run number with the run it repeats, and the reason for any that could not start. Uses conversation credits and calls the agent.

batch.description: Or every run of one launch: the batch_id run_tests or run_suite returned.
batch.title: Batch

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project
